# openwrt_sys_wireless (Data Source)

Retrieves wireless information for a given interface from OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ifname` (String) Wireless interface name (e.g., 'wlan0').

### Read-Only

- `bitrate` (Number) Bitrate in Mb/s.
- `channel` (Number) Current channel.
- `encryption` (String) Encryption mode.
- `essid` (String) Extended SSID.
- `frequency` (Number) Frequency in MHz.
- `id` (String) Internal ID.
- `mode` (String) Operation mode.
- `noise` (Number) Noise level in dBm.
- `signal` (Number) Signal strength in dBm.
- `ssid` (String) SSID name.
- `txpower` (Number) Transmit power in dBm.
